benign.label: Benign
benign.hint: Supposed to be there. No action, ever.

informational.label: Informational
informational.hint: Worth reading once. No action required.

cosmetic.label: Cosmetic
cosmetic.hint: Display art only. Your install is fine.

nuisance.label: Nuisance
nuisance.hint: Noise or a surprising behavior with an open ask. Nothing is broken.

actionable.label: Actionable
actionable.hint: A real fault. Read the row and act.

entries.title: Honest fresh-install line
entries.meaning: A fresh install has no models/state.json yet. The boot prints this honest line and starts with defaults; the file is created on first save. Nothing is wrong. (This is the line a v0.8.6+ tree prints INSTEAD of the old schema-fault misreport below.)
entries.note: Refers to the #244/#258 fix: missing state.json is a friendly default, not corruption.
samples: [brain] state.json missing (fresh install) — starting with defaults (models/state.json will be created on first save)

entries.title: state.json schema fault (corrupt content)
entries.meaning: state.json exists but is unreadable or wrong-typed (truncated write, hand edit, partial file). This is a REAL fault and the runtime refuses loudly by design — restore the file from a backup, or remove it so a fresh default can be seeded.
entries.note: INSIDE the refusals-are-loud fail-closed chain: the runtime never half-writes state.
samples: [brain] state.json schema fault — state.json is not valid JSON (refused: never reaches the runtime pointer)

entries.title: Fresh-install false fault: ENOENT reported as corruption
entries.meaning: An OLD (pre-0.8.6) boot misreported a missing state.json (ENOENT) as corruption. Fixed: a modern install prints the honest line above instead. If you paste this line, you are running a pre-0.8.6 vant — update your clone and the banner is gone.
entries.note: Retired row, kept by the #260 lifecycle: 'fixed in vX.YZ' beats disappearing silently.
samples: [brain] state.json schema fault — unreadable (truncated/corrupt): "ENOENT" (failed: never reaches the runtime pointer)

entries.title: Starter brain seeded without asking
entries.meaning: A first `vant start` planted a starter brain (identity, goals, lessons, start) into models/private/<brain>/ of whatever directory you were standing in — no consent, location, or name ask. Nothing is broken and the files are yours to edit or delete; the consent ask is tracked at the linked issue.
entries.note: Surprise write, not corruption: delete the files or keep them — vant never re-seeds over an existing brain.
samples: [Start] Seeded starter brain: models/private/vant/ (start, identity, goals, lessons).

entries.title: Dangling-hyphen cleanup line
entries.meaning: The hint line under the seed message prints a bare hyphen instead of a readable sentence break. Pure display art; your brain is fine.
entries.re: Edit them freely - they are yours\.
samples: Edit them freely - they are yours.

entries.title: Sandbox not configured
entries.meaning: No sandbox capability policy is configured, so reads/writes allow by default. Convenience posture, not a fault: configure the sandbox in config to enforce the fail-closed capability chain.
entries.note: Fires once per process while boot configures capabilities.
entries.re: Sandbox not configured; allowing by default\.
samples: [storage] Sandbox not configured; allowing by default. Configure sandbox capabilities to enforce.
[brain] Sandbox not configured; allowing by default. Configure sandbox capabilities to enforce.

entries.title: Install-state decode
entries.meaning: Decode of the install-state line on start/onboard: 🌱 fresh = no brain seeded yet, ⏳ legacy = pre-multi-brain layout detected (migrate runs), 🧠 current = multi-brain layout healthy. All three are normal.

entries.title: Bare stack trace, no named reason-code
entries.meaning: A crash reached the surface as a bare stack trace with no named reason code. That violates the 0-1-2 exit contract under the honest-refusal law and is worth filing as a bug with the pasted trace.
entries.note: This checker RETURNS for it because the honest-boot contract says surfacing should be named, not raw.

entries.title: Starter brain seed skipped
entries.meaning: Seeding is a convenience, never a hard failure: an existing brain was found (existing-wins), so the seed refused and moved on. Normal.
samples: [Start] Starter brain seed skipped: already seeded
